title: Cognex: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
author: The Motley Fool Team
description: Cognex reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $313 million (up 19% YoY) with strong profitability gains driven by broad-based demand across industrial end markets. The company is expanding into robotics through its RealSense acquisition and shifting focus from cost reduction to productivity optimization, which should drive operating leverage. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance to $1.14-$1.16 billion.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Record quarterly revenue with 19% YoY growth, four of five end markets showing double-digit growth, raised full-year guidance, expanding into robotics via RealSense acquisition, and shifting to productivity optimization for strong operating leverage. Management demonstrates solid execution and optimism about durable industrial cycle growth.

title: CGNX Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Outlook and Margin Expansion
author: Na
description: Cognex Corporation (CGNX) beat Q3 earnings expectations with EPS of $0.53 and revenues of $313.39M. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $1.143-$1.163B and EBITDA margin outlook to 31-32%, driven by stronger logistics demand and operating leverage. Management expects continued growth across industrial automation, logistics, and electronics markets, while planning the RealSense acquisition to expand robotics capabilities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Cognex exceeded Q3 earnings expectations, raised full-year 2026 guidance for both revenue and EBITDA margins, demonstrated strong double-digit growth across multiple end markets (logistics, electronics, semiconductors), and is expanding addressable markets through the RealSense acquisition. Management expressed confidence in sustained demand and continued margin expansion opportunities.

title: Cognex Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Demand and Margin Expansion
author: Na
description: Cognex Corporation (CGNX) delivered robust third-quarter 2026 results with adjusted earnings surging 60.6% to 53 cents per share and revenues rising 13.2% to $313.39 million, driven by strong factory automation demand and favorable product mix. The company announced plans to acquire RealSense to expand its robotics and AI capabilities, while raising its full-year 2026 revenue and earnings guidance, projecting 67% year-over-year earnings growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q3 earnings beat with 60.6% EPS growth, 13.2% revenue growth, significant margin expansion (1,060 bps EBITDA margin improvement), 11th consecutive quarter of double-digit logistics growth, solid balance sheet with $694.7M cash and no debt, and raised full-year 2026 guidance indicating 67% year-over-year earnings growth. Strategic RealSense acquisition strengthens AI and robotics positioning.
